definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.81) external data matches 2023 3.79 but for may/can; the external records a 2002 program can describe (EXTERNAL file and working-storage records, §2002:13.16.20.2 SR1) are a subset of 2023's, and the 2002 run of l1_cancel_external_unchanged covers the working-storage case.
